name: CloseButton
summary: The round close button: a 24 circle on the neutral fill with a 16 X in the Bold stroke, named "Close" by itself.

a11y.keyboardNote: A real <button> (web) or a Pressable with the button role (native). The accessible name comes from the `close` string ("Close" / "Fechar"); say what closes with `label` when the screen has more than one.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name. Defaults to "Close" ("Fechar" in ptBR); pass what closes when there is more than one on the screen, e.g. "Close notice".

props.name: children
props.description: Replaces the X, as in the reference. Keep it a 16 glyph.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the button; it leaves the focus order.
